sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Someone has to be home when the plumber comes.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I can work from home on Thursday.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Perfect.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Who's picking up the kids on Friday?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll get them, I finish early.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We still need to cancel the old gym membership.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll call them tomorrow morning.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: {S2|owner}, can you book the car service for {DATE_REL|deadline}?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Sure, I'll do it tonight.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The bike needs to go to the shop.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Leave it with me, I'll drop it off on Saturday.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: I'll order the new dishwasher tonight.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: And I'll clear out the old one on the weekend.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Somebody should tell your parents about the dates.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll text my mum after dinner.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: And ask the school about the new pickup rules.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Okay, I'll email them tonight.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We need groceries for the weekend.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I can go after work.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Get coffee too.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Will do.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Can someone call the internet company?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: I'll call them on my lunch break.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Great, thanks.
